title: ModelReport
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool -m <model> model report` (MODEL-REVIEW-SPEC §4) — the comprehension read. `identity` is the header card; `structure` is a lean outline (field paths + kinds, group repeatability — full per-kind config is a `field read` drill-down); `polarity` is the model-level constant (an A12 rule fires on the VIOLATION), carried ONCE; `unreferenced` is the dead-field set (the full field→referrers map is `model usage`, not duplicated here); `rules`/`computations` are the glossed catalog — each in plain language (`gloss`, the tool-computed half) and the verbatim stored `messages` (the modeller's own text), so a reviewer sees what a condition DOES next to what it CLAIMS. A condition rulekit can't model is reported `explained:false` with its kernel-canonical text, never dropped.

structure.description: the lean structure outline (full per-kind config is available via `field read`)

kind.description: the value kind (NUMBER, STRING, DATE, ENUMERATION, …)

polarity.description: why every rule fires — the model-level constant (an A12 rule's condition is TRUE on the VIOLATION), carried once

firesOn.description: what a rule condition fires on — always 'violation'

unreferenced.description: the fields no rule or computation reads — the dead-field audit headline (the full field→referrers map is `model usage`)

rules.description: the glossed rule catalog — every validation rule in plain language

scope.description: the group the rule is scoped to (its grouping key)

explained.description: false when rulekit reads the condition as Opaque

gloss.description: the tool-computed plain-language one-liner (absent when Opaque)

errorField.description: the field the diagnostic attaches to (when set)

messages.description: the verbatim stored messages (the modeller's own text)

computations.description: the glossed computation catalog — every computed field in plain language, with its preconditions (commonPrecondition + per-alternative), in parity with `computation read`

scope.description: the group the computation is scoped to

explained.description: false when rulekit reads the operation as Opaque

computedField.description: the field this computation fills (when explained)

gloss.description: the tool-computed plain-language one-liner (absent when Opaque)

commonPrecondition.description: the precondition gating the WHOLE computation, when set — the DSL text (same shape as `computation read`)

alternatives.description: the (precondition?, operation) formulae — same shape as `computation read`; present when explained

precondition.description: this alternative's precondition, when it has one (absent for a single unconditional operation)

operation.description: the calculated-value operation, as DSL text
